clips.title: The story
paras: Sten Stoutarm gives new recruits a bargain in Coldridge Valley. Hunt wolves and bring back their tough meat for winter rations, and he provides sturdy gloves against Dun Morogh's cold.

Cold waits on every path through Coldridge Valley. Outside Anvilmar, Sten Stoutarm asks new recruits to hunt the wolves prowling the snowy drifts and bring back their tough meat for the outpost. In return, he provides gloves to protect their hands from the cold.

Wolves threaten dwarven scouts and young gnomes training in the valley, yet they also feed the garrison at Anvilmar. Culling them makes the paths between local encampments somewhat safer. Stoutarm's bargain tests a recruit's ability to handle local wildlife while adding food for the bitter nights ahead.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: What do we have here? You look as though you might need something to keep your hands warm, hm?
I'll tell you what would help: a pair of nice, warm gloves. And, being the kind soul that I am, I'd be more than happy to provide you with a suitable pair. I've one condition, however.
I need you to go get me some wolf meat. Nice arrangement, hm? You bring me some wolf meat, and I'll make sure you don't lose any digits to frostbite. Well, what do you say?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah! Wonderful. The wolf meat should do nicely. Oh, don't worry, friend, I wouldn't forget my part of the bargain. Here, one of these should fit you.
